rationale: Apple reports that its Prineville data center opened in May 2012, but Facebook publicly identified its first dedicated Prineville data center on April 7, 2011. The Apple candidate cannot be Crook County's first entry; a complete historical inventory remains unestablished.

Nevada GOED identifies Apple's Washoe County campus and documents its December 2012 opening; the mapped footprint lies within that data-center complex. The evidence does not establish which of the campus buildings entered service first, a complete county inventory, or the absence of earlier government, university, telecom, utility, financial, healthcare, casino, or enterprise operations.
